title: Learning Cardiac Features: ECG Biometrics Across Time and~Exercise
abstract: arXiv:2609.21962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) carry subject-specific patterns enabling reliable individual discrimination, forming the basis of ECG biometrics. Beyond authentication, this paradigm holds significant potential to secure sensitive cardiac data and to serve as a pretext task in self-supervised learning. Yet, most studies remain confined to singlesession, resting data, leaving robustness to temporal and physiological variations largely untested. We address this gap by evaluating ECG biometrics under realistic conditions involving exercise-induced stress and cross-session variability. A Siamese ResNet with late multi-lead fusion strategy is trained on a large ECG dataset extracted from cardiopulmonary exercise tests and evaluated with a exercise-and time-aware protocol, as well as on public benchmarks. This first extensive assessment of ECG biometrics under combined physiological and temporal variability achieves an intra-session rest-to-peak EER

translated_title: 学习心脏特征：跨时间与运动条件下的心电图生物识别
translated_abstract: 心电图（ECG）携带着受试者特异性的模式，能够实现可靠的个体区分，这构成了ECG生物识别技术的基础。除了身份认证之外，这一范式在保护敏感心脏数据安全以及作为自监督学习中的前置任务方面还具有重大潜力。然而，大多数研究仍局限于单次采集的静息数据，其对时间和生理变化的鲁棒性在很大程度上未经检验。我们通过在涉及运动诱发应激和跨会话变化的现实条件下评估ECG生物识别来填补这一空白。我们在从心肺运动试验中提取的大型ECG数据集上，训练了一个采用后期多导联融合策略的孪生ResNet网络，并通过运动与时间感知的评估协议以及公开基准数据集进行验证。这是首次在生理与时间双重变化条件下对ECG生物识别进行的广泛评估，实现了会话内从静息到运动峰值状态的等错误率（EER）……
tldr: 该论文首次在运动应激与跨会话变化等现实条件下系统评估ECG生物识别，采用带后期多导联融合的孪生ResNet，验证了其对时间和生理变异的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first extensive evaluation of ECG biometrics under combined exercise-induced stress and cross-session variability, using a Siamese ResNet with late multi-lead fusion to demonstrate robustness to temporal and physiological variations.
